events.headline: Huang exit and US scrutiny imperil $3 billion in Chinese AI projects reliant on Nvidia
events.summary: Reuters reviewed over 150 procurement and investment records identifying more than $3.2 billion of Chinese AI projects involving restricted Nvidia processors. The figure includes supporting infrastructure and projects at different stages; access to chips and potential redesigns remain uncertain.

events.headline: S&P 500, Nasdaq end lower as Nvidia uncertainty weighs on tech shares
events.summary: The Nasdaq lost 0.91% and the S&P 500 fell 0.40% on Friday as Nvidia governance uncertainty weighed on chips and AI infrastructure. October US producer prices rose 6.5% year over year, sustaining expectations of a December Fed rate increase.

events.headline: Investors flock to Anthropic IPO but question durability of AI lead
events.summary: Sources told Reuters that Anthropic's IPO order book was six times oversubscribed by Thursday, with a roughly $64 billion offering expected to price next week. Investors remain concerned about competition and whether the company's AI leadership is durable; reported order levels may change.

events.headline: Cerebras shares surge as forecast raise, surprise profit ease AI spending worries
events.summary: Cerebras raised 2026 adjusted revenue guidance to $940 million-$960 million and reported a surprise adjusted profit of $29.82 million. It said OpenAI deal delivery delays reflected land and power shortages rather than chip manufacturing constraints.

events.headline: Neoclouds, AI stocks slide again as Nvidia turmoil rattles sector
events.summary: AI cloud providers CoreWeave and Nebius fell sharply in Friday trading amid concerns that Nvidia's leadership transition could change vendor financing support. Nscale also disclosed a widening expected loss in an amended IPO filing.

events.headline: Microsoft says consumer products services recovered; still monitoring enterprise services
events.summary: Microsoft said consumer services recovered while Microsoft 365 enterprise services were still being monitored after a widespread disruption. The company was tracking a backlog of email messages before declaring enterprise recovery complete.

events.headline: US to resume flights after air traffic network failure sparks chaos
events.summary: A US air-traffic communications failure triggered a nationwide ground stop and thousands of flight cancellations before the FAA lifted the restriction. Officials cited overloaded networking equipment and said no evidence of a cyberattack had been established.

events.headline: Canada, US make progress on trade deal, Carney says
events.summary: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney said Canada and the United States had made progress on trade discussions. Details of any final agreement and implementation were not established in the accessible report.
